title: refactor(Development/AbelianVarietyTheory): deduplicate short lattice vector trace-determinant proof
body:
Deduplicates the Minkowski trace-determinant short lattice vector construction shared between `ExistsShortOfTraceDet.lean`, `ExistsIntMulIsIntegralOfTrace.lean`, and `ShortLatticeVectorBoundedSizeOfOrthogonalFrame.lean` with no new imports.

Declarations changed:
- Replaced `GlobalTheory.HermClass.exists_short_of_trace_det` in `ExistsShortOfTraceDet.lean` with the more general `GlobalTheory.HermClass.exists_short_coord` parameterized by an explicit orthogonal basis and also returning the per-coordinate bound, and removed the duplicate `GlobalTheory.SmoothForms.Short.exists_short_coord` from `ShortLatticeVectorBoundedSizeOfOrthogonalFrame.lean`.
- Extracted `GlobalTheory.HermClass.exists_trace_det_basis` in `ExistsIntMulIsIntegralOfTrace.lean` for the shared `ℤ`-basis, real bilinear form, and trace Gram determinant bound, and updated both `GlobalTheory.HermClass.exists_bound_short` and `GlobalTheory.SmoothForms.Short.shortSmall` to call it together with `GlobalTheory.HermClass.exists_short_coord`.
